name: Odyssey Technologies Limited
about: Odyssey Technologies Limited engages in developing software focusing on public key infrastructure, cryptography, and other related services in India. The company's authentication solutions include Snorkel-TX, a multifactor authentication server for internet banking and e-commerce applications; and Snorkel-BX, a file transfer application. It also provides Certrix, a certifying authority server software for issuing and managing digital certificates; Odyssey ERA which carries out registration and other subscriber interaction functions and registration authority server to resolve user-base problems; CerTrust, a validation solution for enterprises for managing digital certificates; ClockTix, a time stamp server software; and Crypta Key Crawler which discovers and manages digital certificates and keys across the enterprise. In addition, the company offers Odyssey eSign, an electronic signature service; AltaSigna Enterprise, a document creation, signing, and distribution application; AltaSigna Maple, an automated signing and verification tool; AltaSigna Pine, an e-mandate signature and verification solution; and Crypta Vault that tokenizes and secures sensitive data. Further, it provides xorkee services; xorkeesign, which helps users and businesses to digitally sign files, documents, and emails and verify it; and xorkeeauth, which helps service providers to authenticate users to their applications. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
